correctness.rationale: First-order pure-state Lindblad variance is reconstructed directly for both antipodal inputs; the polar angular-distance speed bound and one-dimensional area formula give a positive residual residence measure of exact mass Δ. Its first two supported moments give necessary parabolic inequalities; an explicit two-atom measure and two-dwell capped-speed meridian pulse realize each pair. Ratio equality follows from strict integrand bounds. Boundary T=π/Ω and all h,q extreme cases are handled. A 4,445-assertion standalone numeric/algebraic checker was executed; the infinite theorem rests on the displayed analytic argument.

value.rationale: The two-input error-pair attainable region under a physically natural bounded-drive and duration constraint is a natural complete quantum-control classification, not one arbitrary pulse comparison. The result identifies all possible simultaneous error compromises, supplies a small-support synthesis for any allowed point, and distinguishes a universal all-controls ratio bound from prior examples confined to wait–flip–wait paths. It offers an exact diagnostic baseline for direction-dependent fidelity under amplitude damping, while making no finite-noise or noise-model generalization.
